title: Resistance Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct formula for resistance R between the conductors.

title: Capacitance Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct formula for capacitance C between the conductors.

title: Use of Ohm's Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Ohm's law to relate current and electric field.

title: Electric Field Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the electric field expression correctly between the conductors.

title: Charge Density Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate the surface charge density correctly using the boundary relation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios for the derived formulas.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the equations for resistance and capacitance.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as 2 pi and l, are included in the final answers.
